data.title: Russia Will Soon Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms
data.description: Russians have until July 1, 2027 to buy and sell crypto directly with each other. After that, every trade runs through a broker or exchange approved by the Bank of Russia.
